{
  "$schema": "https://www.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "dotclaude-codegraph",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Gives Claude the code graph of a project from the CodeGraph CLI `codegraph`. Syncs the index at session start, after an edit, and after a `git` command that changes the tree. Adds one line about the graph commands at session start.",
  "author": {
    "name": "xsyetopz"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/xsyetopz/dotclaude",
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/xsyetopz/dotclaude/wiki/Code-Graph",
  "keywords": [
    "codegraph",
    "code-graph",
    "search",
    "index"
  ]
}
